text_block_list.text:
Today was the day of the monthly dorm deep cleaning.
Espoir City was scheduled to join a team with other Umamusume
and participate starting in the morning, but...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oops, City. Still in dreamland?
...*yaaaawn*.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
An early morning shoot... They insisted on this time.
What about you?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
A buddy of mine was pretty down in the dumps.
I listened to them over the phone, and before I knew it, it was past midnight...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, stop spacing out!
You'll never finish at this rate!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah... I'm sorry, Espoir-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Geez. If you keep dragging your feet,
people are gonna laugh and say, "Look how lame that group is," y'know?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Listen up, guys! For today's big cleaning, our group's gonna finish way ahead of everyone else!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You're really fired up, Senpai.
You're wiping down the floor so briskly.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No kidding. Let's shift into gear
and catch up to Espo, too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The floor feels pretty gritty around here...
It might be better to move the furniture first.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Let's sweep up our side first.
City, grab that end of the shelf."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
! Hey, wait...!
Doing that with two people is—!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ready, and―― ...Ah, hold on, my hand's――

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh, seriously? Sorry, move over this way—whoa!

text_block_list.name: City & Tap
text_block_list.text:
—Eek!!
—Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"You idiot, what the hell are you doing?!
That's dangerous!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Sorry...! That seriously freaked me out...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Jeez, if you act like that,
people are gonna mock us saying,
'That squad is a total mess!'

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way in hell I'm lettin' myself get lumped in with you!
If you're just gonna mess up, back off for now!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh? But...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
The way you guys are right now, you're just dead weight!
Just get the hell out of here!

Passing near the student dorms,
I saw two Umamusume enjoying the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Yikes...
I really messed up big time..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah. But that vibe from Espo-senpai... I don't know if she was mad, or rather...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
—And so I got kicked out.
...Well, maybe I did push myself a bit too hard, though.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Still... knowing her,
I'm sure she wasn't just mad for no reason~.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
How do I put it... The very second we let our guard down,
she shut us down hard, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Saying "Don't space out"—
I wonder if they could tell I didn't get enough sleep.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Get outside" was probably her way of sending a message, too. Surely.
choice_data_list: Yeah, though their words are pretty harsh.
Yeah, their words are harsh, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...In that case, we better switch gears.
Doesn't seem like we have time to space out.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Huh? That's――"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? And why're you here too?
choice_data_list: Just kind of went with the flow.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Um... Espo-senpai.
I'm sorry about earlier.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Also, whatever happened with
cleaning that place?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I told you, I finished that crap ages ago.
And also... here, take this.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Oh? Coffee?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"If you guys stay half-asleep,
they're gonna lump me in with you lot."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wake yourself up before your next post.
If you screw up again, I'm seriously not gonna forgive you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Espo-senpai, seriously,
you're always like that, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? What are you saying?
choice_data_list: We were just talking about how caring you are.
We were just saying how caring you are.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaahh~~~!?
Stop talking utter nonsense, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm just telling you to pull your act together so people don't look down on us!
When you bastards slack off, it causes real trouble for me!
choice_data_list: Even so, you're being a good senior, aren't you?
Even so, you're being a good senior, aren't you?
In that case, good luck with the rest of the cleaning!
In that case, good luck with the rest of the cleaning!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm just telling you to pull your act together so people don't look down on us!
When you bastards slack off, it causes real trouble for me!
choice_data_list: Even so, you're being a good senior, aren't you?
Even so, you're being a good senior, aren't you?
In that case, good luck with the rest of the cleaning!
In that case, good luck with the rest of the cleaning!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Are your eyes made of glass or something!?
How on earth did you look at me and see that!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Swap out those eyeballs and try again, punk!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Hmph... Mind your own business!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
As soon as you guys finish drinking, get right back to it!
You're gonna make up for the lost time, got it?

text_block_list.name: City & Tap
text_block_list.text:
—Yes!
—Yeah!
